Priya (eng-platform): FYI I merged the notify-mapping default change to staging earlier. console /notify/preview shows much higher fanout than expected for some tenants.
Ben (sre): saw that, repro'd locally. estimate metrics look like: notify.fanout_estimate = 6.2, avg_targets = 4.8. that's > our intended default of 3.
Carmen (product): oof. is this the new per-route fallback logic or the broader default policy we introduced? users will freak if they suddenly get more alerts.
Priya (eng-platform): it's the combination: we set a more permissive fallback and turned on per-tenant contact expansion by default. the PR default was meant to be conservative but I misread one flag.
Mateo (eng): quick patch suggestion: clamp default fanout to min(3, calculated) and surface a compact preview in the console showing "expected fanout" and why (route matches, group aliases).
Ben (sre): agree on clamp. also telemetry questions: what sample window are the preview numbers using? right now preview queries last_24h which amplifies bursty spikes.
Priya (eng-platform): preview uses last_24h by default. we can change to last_7d for preview and keep 24h for live routing decisions. that should smooth spikes.
Carmen (product): UX note: when preview differs from live routing we should show a tooltip: "Preview uses 7d sample — live may differ based on current signal." helps with rollouts.
Mateo (eng): quick config snippet we could apply server-side:
```
notify:
  preview_sample_window: 7d
  default_fanout_limit: 3
  per_tenant_expansion: true
```
Priya (eng-platform): LGTM. also adding a small backoff heuristic: if a tenant has >20% of recent alerts from a single rule, downweight expansion for that tenant for 24h.
Ben (sre): good safety net. how are we emitting telemetry so SRE can validate impact? need specs for metrics and event tags.
Priya (eng-platform): plan to emit: notify.preview_fanout, notify.live_fanout, notify.expansion_applied (bool), notify.reason_tags (list). plus per-tenant tag: tenant.id.
Carmen (product): add a UI health banner that says "Preview vs Live: X% difference" when >30% so customers know to expect variance.
Mateo (eng): also add an admin toggle in console: "Enforce conservative defaults" that will set default_fanout_limit=2 for new tenants while we ramp.
DeployBot: deploy started: staging/notify-mapping v3 -> 3 instances. build 2026-03-21T14:22:03Z
Ben (sre): once deployed can we run a quick A/B check on ~100 tenants to compare notify.preview_fanout vs notify.live_fanout over 48h?
Priya (eng-platform): yes. I'll schedule the job and post results in this thread. thanks all :)
